name: remote-debug-docs-systemd
title: remote-debug docs: prefer --unit on systemd-only distros
description: remote-debug SKILL.md/references examples use /var/log/syslog as the canonical path, but Debian 12+ / RHEL 9+ and many modern distros ship journald-only and have no syslog file. Add a note in references guiding users to prefer 'tail_log --unit <service>' over path mode on systemd-only distros. Reference Finding #3 in validation-report.md of parent task.
creator: jason
